races.paceDynamic: Itsonlyrockandroll will be the lone leader from the start and should dictate proceedings at her own tempo. With no other front-runners to pressure her, she can control the fractions and create a steady, sustainable gallop early. The predominantly hold-up runners (Forever Perfect, Corduroy, Crown Inn To Win, Steel Fixer) will settle back and rely on late runs, while Moon Is Up sits closer but has a tendency to fade in the finish. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can time their challenges perfectly off the controlled pace, with the prominent runner Moon Is Up vulnerable due to her finishing limitations.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Itsonlyrockandroll sets moderate fractions without pressure upfront
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade can unleash perfectly timed challenges in the final two furlongs off the steady gallop. Crown Inn To Win and Corduroy benefit most from their proven finishing kicks and recent course form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Itsonlyrockandroll quickens two furlongs out before closers can respond
scenarios.body: Her uncontested early lead allows her to steal crucial lengths when increasing the tempo, holding off late challenges. The Gosden yard improvement factor makes this scenario viable despite her modest form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moon Is Up Times It
scenarios.trigger: If Moon Is Up overcomes her fading tendency and sustains her challenge
scenarios.body: Her prominent position gives her first run on the field when the pace lifts, getting clear before the hold-up horses can respond. However, her historical finishing weakness makes this unlikely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Slow Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Itsonlyrockandroll goes too slowly and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with multiple horses converging late in a bunched finish. This chaotic scenario could favour any horse getting the clearest run, but seems unlikely given the lone leader setup.

Itsonlyrockandroll could show marked improvement in her handicap debut for the powerful Gosden operation despite poor maiden form
Steel Fixer faces the unknown of all-weather racing and a significant trip increase after being well beaten on turf return
Forever Perfect's patient hold-up style should be perfectly suited if the lone leader sets steady early fractions

races.paceDynamic: Smooth Silesie is the sole confirmed pace-setter and will likely dictate terms from the front without pressure, given most rivals prefer to sit off the pace. The lack of early speed creates a tactical race where hold-up horses like Shalaa Asker, Em Four, Diomed Spirit and Phoenix Beach will be looking to time their runs from behind the leaders. With Binadham and Midnight Call likely to take prominent positions behind Smooth Silesie, the pace should be sustainable early before quickening late. This race shape strongly favours closers and hold-up horses who can unleash finishing kicks in the final furlong when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers' Paradise Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If Smooth Silesie sets steady fractions and the pace doesn't truly quicken until inside the final furlong.
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing speed with Shalaa Asker and Em Four best positioned to capitalize. Phoenix Beach and Diomed Spirit also benefit from this tactical affair that plays to their strengths.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Smooth Silesie gets away with soft sectionals and the closers leave their runs too late on this sharp track.
scenarios.body: The mare gets first run on her rivals and holds on gamely, with the prominent racers Binadham and Midnight Call picking up the pieces. The hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the lack of early pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pressure Applied
scenarios.trigger: If Binadham or Midnight Call apply pressure to Smooth Silesie from the 2f pole, creating a strong gallop.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up perfectly for the late-running Em Four and Shalaa Asker to sweep past tired leaders. Phoenix Beach also benefits from the honest pace that develops.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If nobody wants to go early and they go very slowly through the opening half-mile.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery sprint from the 2f marker with positioning crucial on this tight track. Midnight Call and Binadham's prominent styles give them the edge over horses further back.

watchPoints.text: Smooth Silesie could steal this if allowed to bowl along in front unchallenged given the lack of early pace in this field.
Shalaa Asker needs a clear passage in the home straight as this consistent performer has been finishing fast lately.
Em Four's 8-day turnaround could be significant as the Osborne team are in good form and this trip suits perfectly.
Phoenix Beach has the class edge if reproducing his best form but has been inconsistent lately at higher grades.
Midnight Call faces a big step up in grade after her recent course win but Tony Carroll's 5/26 strike rate is concerning.

races.paceDynamic: The Bay Warrior is the sole confirmed front runner and will likely dictate terms from the start alongside prominent runner Phyllis Burton. With most of the field comprised of hold-up horses (Rubellite, Three Yorkshiremen, Wave Rock, Knight Of Magic, Beaune, Late Claim), the early pace should be sustainable rather than punishing. The lack of pace pressure means The Bay Warrior can bowl along comfortably, setting up a tactical race where positioning will be crucial in the straight. This race shape strongly favours the early pace-setters and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large group of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If The Bay Warrior gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady gallop
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows him to control the race completely, making it difficult for the hold-up brigade to peg him back. Rose Dawes can dictate when to quicken and the field will struggle to close the gap in time.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their preferred scenario with a sprint finish, allowing the best handicapped runners to show their true ability. Traffic will be an issue but class can prevail in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Win
scenarios.trigger: If Phyllis Burton can track The Bay Warrior and outstay him
scenarios.body: The P J McDonald-ridden filly benefits from the perfect stalking position, staying close enough to strike but avoiding over-use. Her stamina reserves prove decisive when The Bay Warrior's effort flattens out.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos In Running

scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with the leader either stopping quickly or multiple horses making premature moves. This creates a muddling pace that suits nothing, with the winner coming from an unexpected position.

races.paceDynamic: Havana Joy is the sole confirmed front runner in this small field and will set a sustainable pace without pressure from the flag. Crystal Dagger may press from a prominent position but lacks the early speed to challenge Havana Joy's lead. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Tabby, Daytona Lady, Filly Foden, Star Marian) will settle behind and rely on late runs. This tactical setup strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the back-markers in a six-runner sprint.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Havana Joy breaks cleanly and sets steady fractions without harassment.
scenarios.body: She dictates terms throughout and proves hard to peg back despite recent poor form, while Crystal Dagger benefits from the prominent pressing position. The hold-up brigade gets caught behind horses and arrives too late.

scenarios.body: The sprint becomes a dash from the 2f pole where class tells and the strongest finishers prevail. Star Marian's recent win and Daytona Lady's fitness edge prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses bunch together turning for home and impede each other.
scenarios.body: Multiple runners get blocked or have to switch wide, allowing the leaders to maintain their advantage despite modest ability. Havana Joy and Crystal Dagger benefit from clear sailing.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Speed Returns
scenarios.trigger: If Filly Foden rediscovers her early-season 5f pace at this longer trip.
scenarios.body: Her superior tactical speed allows her to overcome the unfavorable draw and running style. The race becomes a test of pure acceleration where class rises to the top.

races.paceDynamic: Faster Bee is the sole confirmed front-runner and will likely lead unchallenged from the start, setting his own tempo over this 7f trip. With Bungle Bay and Diligent Henry providing some forward support but not true pace pressure, this creates a sustainable rhythm that won't stretch the field early. The lack of genuine pace competition means Faster Bee can dictate terms while prominent runners like these two track comfortably behind. This moderate early pace strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position themselves handily without expending energy, while hold-up horses face the challenge of making up ground against horses who haven't been softened up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Faster Bee leads without serious early pressure from Bungle Bay or Diligent Henry
scenarios.body: He can dictate a comfortable tempo and kick for home with energy reserves intact. The lack of pace duel allows him to control the race from pillar to post exactly as he did when winning over C&D in February.

races.paceDynamic: Bad Habits will take this field along as the only confirmed front runner, likely to get an uncontested lead through the early stages. With eight hold-up horses behind her, there's no pace pressure expected, allowing Bad Habits to dictate comfortable fractions. The lack of early speed means the field will bunch up turning for home, creating a sprint finish from the furlong pole. This tactical scenario strongly favours horses with a turn of foot who can quicken in the final 200 yards, making prominent runners and those with tactical speed the profiles to follow.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Bad Habits gets easy early fractions and maintains her kick
scenarios.body: She controls the tempo completely and has enough left to resist late challengers in a race that becomes a test of stamina rather than speed. Her recent close seconds show she's ready to capitalise on ideal conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches up behind Bad Habits turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a cavalry charge in the final two furlongs where horses with the best turn of foot prevail. Recent course winners and those showing sharp acceleration benefit most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If David Egan positions Top Star closer than usual to the pace
scenarios.body: The experienced jockey uses tactical nous to sit fourth or fifth, avoiding the late traffic problems that will affect the deeper hold-up horses. Top Star's recent form suggests he has the acceleration to strike when it matters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Course Specialist Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the Wolverhampton track bias favours proven course performers
scenarios.body: Ravenglass and So Chic's multiple course victories become decisive factors as they know exactly where to be positioned. Their familiarity with the unique characteristics of this all-weather surface gives them a crucial edge.

races.paceDynamic: Karakula stands alone as the sole front-runner in this six-horse field, giving him complete control to dictate a steady, uncontested gallop over the extended 1m1½f trip. With Distinction, Kaaranah, Nuptown Girl, Eagles Whistle and Moonlit Cloud all preferring to settle off the pace, this creates a tactical nightmare for the hold-up brigade who will be relying on each other to provide the tempo. The lack of early pressure allows Karakula to conserve energy through moderate fractions before quickening when it matters. This race shape strongly favours the pace-setter and any horse with enough natural speed to track close behind the leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Karakula Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Karakula gets his ideal moderate tempo from the front without harassment
scenarios.body: His uncontested lead allows perfect energy conservation before he can kick clear in the straight, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back after a steady pace. The front-runner's tactical advantage proves decisive over this stamina-sapping distance.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Flies Late
scenarios.trigger: If one of the closers times their run perfectly despite the tactical disadvantage
scenarios.body: The slow early pace sets up a sprint finish where raw class can overcome poor positioning, with the best horse on ratings finding a turn of foot. Superior ability trumps tactics in a dash to the line.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Karakula Folds Under Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If the favourite cannot handle the step back up in class and weakens tamely
scenarios.body: His long absence and moderate recent form catches up as fitness tells, leaving the door open for a swooping hold-up horse with more race-fitness. The pace collapses become a war of attrition.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all horses settle too far back creating a crawling gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint from the home turn with little rhythm, suiting the most versatile performer who can adapt. Chaos favours the horse with the best recent form regardless of running style.
